title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase has come down from its late-morning high and is edging down now. Kula Ag had deep shade over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 4 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Kamehameha Schools, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
